mapper.select:
select id, ( select b.region_name from t_std_region b where b.region_id=a.up_region_id limit 1)region_name , up_region_id, name, ip, port, address, protocol, type, device_id, total_positive_power, total_positive_reactive_power, total_negative_positive_power, collect_power_time, create_time, magnification_coefficient from t_meter a where 1=1
and a.up_region_id in
#{regionId}
and a.name like concat('%',#{meterName},'%')
mapper.insert: insert into t_meter (up_region_id, name, ip, port, address, protocol, type, device_id, magnification_coefficient) values ( #{upRegionId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{name,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ip,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{port,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{address,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{protocol,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{type,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{deviceId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{magnificationCoefficient,jdbcType=BIGINT} )
mapper.update: update t_meter set total_positive_power = #{totalPositivePower,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, total_positive_reactive_power = #{totalPositiveReactivePower,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, total_negative_positive_power = #{totalNegativePositivePower,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, collect_power_time= now() where id = #{id,jdbcType=BIGINT}
mapper.select: SELECT SUM(a.total_positive_power) as allTotal, b.region_name FROM `t_meter` a left join t_std_region b on a.up_region_id = b.region_id GROUP BY a.up_region_id

SELECT ROUND(SUM(a.total_positive_power_difference_value * a.magnification_coefficient),2) as allTotal, b.region_name as regionName FROM `t_meter_log` a left join t_std_region b on a.edge_code = b.region_code where b.state = 1 and a.create_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime} GROUP BY a.edge_code
SELECT ROUND(SUM(a.total_positive_power * a.magnification_coefficient),2) as allTotal FROM `t_meter` a
SELECT * FROM `t_meter` a where a.device_id is not null
